resources.name: Thermochemical coefficients for gas-phase and condensed-phase species

access.notes: Provided in the paper's Table 1 (ΔGf° coefficients for O, U, UO, UO2, UO3, UO2(c)) and Table 2 (oxygen-potential model constants A1,B1,A2,B2 for solid and A11,B11,A21,B21 for liquid). The agent must embed these numerical constants in the implementation.
Described in the paper: monotectic temperature 2700 K, normal melting point 3120 K, solidus approximations with linear segments. The agent implements phase selection logic based on these boundaries.
